# bitbucket_workspace_hook (Resource)

A webhook on a Bitbucket Cloud workspace, firing for events across every repository in it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bitbucket_workspace_hook" "ci_notify" {
  url    = "https://ci.example.com/bitbucket-webhook"
  active = true
  events = ["repo:push"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `events` (List of String) Events that trigger this webhook, e.g. ["repo:push", "pullrequest:created"].
- `url` (String) URL Bitbucket sends the webhook payload to.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the webhook is active. Defaults to true.
- `description` (String) Description of the webhook.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier, formatted as "workspace/uuid".
- `uuid` (String) Bitbucket-assigned UUID of the webhook.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import bitbucket_workspace_hook.ci_notify {webhook-uuid}
```
